messages:
katie: RCA posted for the serving-degradation incident — https://redwood.internal/docs/rca/1728524689
katie: Quick TL;DR: transient autoscaler race + unexpected KV-cache eviction spike led to increased tail latency and elevated 5xx rates during the 11:30–12:10 PDT window.
katie: Doc includes executive summary, timeline, root cause analysis, mitigations taken, and an action-items table with owners + target dates. JIRA epic: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RWD-1234
katie: Key action items (short):
  • Autoscaler race fix — owner: devon — target: 2024-06-07
  • Cache eviction metric + alarm (p95/p99 split) — owner: sanjay — target: 2024-05-24
  • Canary rollback/config policy update + playbook note — owner: mira — target: 2024-05-21
  • Add CI perf regression test for the autoscaler path — owner: devon — target: 2024-05-30
Please ACK if you own an item or comment ASAP if dates need adjusting. We'll do a 30-day checkpoint/lessons-learned sync on 2024-06-23 (calendar invite coming).
devon: ack — I own the autoscaler fix. PR in draft at branch autoscaler/2024-fix, running unit + e2e. I'll request reviews EOD.
mira: ack — I'll take the canary rollback config. Quick q: does this require any Console UI changes or just config + playbook updates?
katie: no UI work needed for the initial change, mira — it's config + playbook. If we decide to expose controls later we can open a UX ticket.
sanjay: ack — I'll add the eviction metric and set a pro-active alert. Suggest thresholds: p95 latency > 200ms AND eviction-rate > 0.02 for 3m. Will add details in the RCA doc.
devon: thanks. Also adding a CI perf job to run trimmed throughput tests on PRs touching autoscaler code. tagging @eng-infra for runners.
opsbot: Created JIRA subtasks: RWD-1234-1 (autoscaler fix) assigned to devon, RWD-1234-2 (cache alert) assigned to sanjay, RWD-1234-3 (canary playbook) assigned to mira. Links: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RWD-1234-1
katie: great — I'll update the action-items table with those JIRA links and add owners to the weekly check-in. If anyone can't make the 30-day checkpoint, please indicate availability or add a delegate in the doc.
mira: noted. I'll add a short playbook snippet and a rollback checklist into the doc today.
devon: PR ready for review — requesting @sre-team and @eng-runtime review. Will merge once CI green.
sanjay: will tune alert thresholds after one day of baseline data, will post follow-up in the doc.
katie: thanks team — appreciate the quick responses. If you spot anything missing in the RCA (logs/trace links, additional timelines), comment directly in the doc. :thumbsup:
note: This thread announces a published RCA and lists action items, owners, and follow-up checkpoints.
